name: 2019-2c-recuperatorio
title: The Towers Game
description: A chess variant on an 8x8 board where each player has two rooks ('towers'): alternating turns, straight-line moves without jumping, captured towers return to their original square (or the next free square towards the center) with a 3-square movement limit for their next 4 moves, and each side wins by occupying a given pair of central squares. The student must design and test the whole game from scratch.

design.notes: Many interacting rules to model from nothing: whose turn / who won as game states, tower colour as polymorphism instead of ifs, a per-tower moving state (normal vs limited for 4 moves) that changes on capture, path-blocking checks over the board, and relocation of an eaten tower towards the center.
